sources.title: Add a debit or credit card to the Google Wallet app
sources.page_scope: Card add flow, issuer approval, device security errors, card removal triggers
sources.claim: Cards are added via camera/manual entry, tap-to-read (select countries) or the issuer's 'Add to GPay'; issuer terms and verification follow; the issuer alone approves tokenization.
caveats: Max number of cards per device exists but no number is stated
Rooted/custom-ROM/unlocked-bootloader devices cannot tap to pay
Cards auto-removed after screen lock removal or 90 days without opening Wallet
sources.local_note: Add to Wallet > Payment card > New credit or debit card; read Issuer Terms; verify. 'final decision to approve a card for Google Wallet rests solely with the card issuer'. Eligible cards get a virtual card automatically. Cards removed if screen lock off or Wallet unopened 90+ days.

sources.title: Find supported payment methods - United States
sources.page_scope: US issuer/card support table and NFC requirement
sources.claim: Contactless payments need an NFC Android phone; the bank decides whether its cards work and can restrict any card.
caveats: Large issuer table not transcribed card-by-card
sources.local_note: To make contactless payments you need an Android phone with NFC. 'Your bank decides if its cards work with Google Wallet. Banks can restrict any of their cards from making mobile payments.'

sources.title: Tap to pay with your phone
sources.page_scope: In-store phone tap-to-pay setup, use and returns
sources.claim: Tap to pay requires NFC on, Google Wallet as default NFC payment app, a contactless card from a supported country, screen lock and device security; default card is used.
caveats: Returns may require last 4 of the virtual (token) card number
sources.local_note: Requirements: NFC on, Google Pay default payment app, contactless payment method, screen lock, security requirements. Tap unlocked phone to reader; blue check mark on success. Declined transactions are not charged.

sources.title: Verify it's you to make a purchase
sources.page_scope: Payment verification methods and transit verification exception
sources.claim: Payments require screen-lock verification (PIN, pattern, password, Class 3 biometric) with a timeout; transit verification can be turned off for card payments.
caveats: Pixel 7/7 Pro Face Unlock not supported for tap to pay
Some transit systems do not support skipping verification
sources.local_note: Verify with PIN, pattern, password or Class 3 biometric; not Class 1/2 or Smart Unlock. After verification times out, verify again. Wallet settings > Security > Verification settings > Transit payments > turn off Verification required.

sources.title: Fix problems with tap to pay transactions
sources.page_scope: Tap-to-pay troubleshooting checklist
sources.claim: Tap to pay needs NFC, default wallet set, card added, screen lock, Play Protect certified device and an unlocked device.
sources.local_note: Checklist: device supports NFC; set Google Wallet as default payment app; add a card; set a screen lock; phone certified (Play Protect); unlock device before payment.

sources.title: Tap to pay with your smartwatch
sources.page_scope: Wear OS watch payments, express pay, default card
sources.claim: Wear OS 2.0+ watches with NFC in supported regions can hold their own cards and pay without the phone; express pay (no app open) only on Pixel Watch 2+ and rolling out.
caveats: Express pay rollout incomplete
Amex card limited to 10 devices
Removing watch screen lock deletes cards
sources.local_note: Wear OS 2.0+, NFC, supported country, Wallet app on watch, supported card. If you add a card to your watch you don't need your phone to pay. Express pay only supported on Pixel Watch 2+; rolling out. American Express allows your card on up to 10 devices.

sources.title: Tap to pay with your Fitbit device
sources.page_scope: Fitbit Wallet payments
sources.claim: Listed Fitbit Versa/Sense/Charge/Ace LTE devices can tap to pay in supported regions with a 4-digit device PIN; some phone-supported cards are not supported on Fitbit.
sources.local_note: Devices: Versa SE, Versa 2-4, Sense, Sense 2, Charge 3 SE, Charge 4-6, Fitbit Ace LTE. Set a 4-digit PIN. Some cards supported on Android phone may not be supported on Fitbit.

sources.title: Use virtual cards to pay online or in apps - Computer
sources.page_scope: Online/in-app virtual card numbers via Chrome/Android autofill
sources.claim: Saved eligible cards may get a virtual card number for online/in-app autofill; availability is limited to select banks/networks/countries; some merchants opt out.
caveats: Separate from the device token used for tap to pay
sources.local_note: Virtual card shared with merchant online/in-app via Chrome autofill. Only for select banks or networks in select countries. Can't use on merchant sites that opted out. Turn on in chrome://settings/payments or wallet.google.com.

sources.title: About buy now, pay later with Google Pay
sources.page_scope: BNPL provider selection at Google Pay online checkout
sources.claim: US/UK users at select merchants can pick a BNPL provider (Affirm, Zip, Afterpay, Klarna) at Google Pay checkout over $35 / GBP 30; financing is offered by providers, not Google.
caveats: Eligibility determined by provider
Payment plan details come from provider
Android 10+ required
sources.local_note: Available in US and UK at select merchants for purchases over $35 (US) / 30 GBP (UK). Financing isn't offered by Google. Providers: Affirm, Zip, Afterpay, Klarna. Eligibility isn't determined by Google Pay.

sources.title: Keep your payment info safe
sources.page_scope: Security, virtual card tokens, privacy disclosure, fraud reporting, lost device
sources.claim: Card numbers are replaced by virtual cards; screen lock required; locked device cannot pay in stores; erasing a lost device removes cards; report unauthorized charges within 120 days.
caveats: Merchant 'has Google Pay' disclosure is opt-out
sources.local_note: Virtual card with randomly generated number replaces actual card number. Screen lock required for in-store payments. Report fraud within 120 days of transaction date. Erasing your device removes payment info. Google discloses to merchants whether you have Google Pay set up; you can opt out.

sources.title: View transactions on the Google Wallet app
sources.page_scope: In-app transaction list, verification, notifications, location
sources.claim: Wallet shows past transactions behind identity verification with search and details; merchants may not share full details and Wallet does not replace receipts or bank statements.
caveats: Removing a card or pass may lose its transaction history
No retention window stated
sources.local_note: Sometimes merchants do not share all purchase details. Check your bank statement. Transactions hidden unless you verify it's you. Search transactions. Purchase notifications toggle. Location permission for detailed receipts.

sources.title: View transactions on the Google Wallet website
sources.page_scope: Web transaction history and search
sources.claim: wallet.google.com shows contactless, virtual-card online and Plaid-linked (US) transactions, searchable by merchant, amount, date, category, refunds; Google Play/YouTube/Google One purchases excluded.
caveats: Some transactions only shown for a short period
Remember me skips verification for 30 days
sources.local_note: Shows contactless payments, virtual card transactions online, transactions from Plaid linked accounts (US only). Search by business name, amount, date, category, refunds. Some transactions might only be available for a short period.

sources.title: Manage payment methods on the Google Wallet website
sources.page_scope: Web payment method management, bank accounts, VCN toggle, BNPL providers
sources.claim: Website can add/edit/remove cards, add a US bank account verified by micro-deposit, toggle virtual card numbers (US), view/remove linked BNPL providers and remove a card from a specific device.
caveats: Removing on web may not remove from app device
sources.local_note: Add a bank account (US only): deposit under $0.25 labeled GOOGLE in 2-3 days, then verify amount. Turn virtual card numbers on/off (US only). Removing a BNPL provider doesn't affect scheduled loan payments. Remove from device per listed device.

sources.title: Manage payment methods added to the Google Wallet app
sources.page_scope: App card edit/reorder/remove/nickname, issuer auto-update
sources.claim: Users can reorder, remove and nickname cards in-app (edits happen on the web); banks may auto-update lost/expired cards so the new card works for tap to pay before the plastic arrives.
sources.local_note: Edit expiration/CVC/name/address online. Bank may automatically update a lost, damaged, stolen or expired card. Reorder via Edit card order (doesn't change default). Nickname letters only, fewer than 25 characters.

sources.title: View & track your online orders in Google Wallet
sources.page_scope: Gmail-derived online orders and package tracking
sources.claim: US-only: with Gmail settings enabled, Wallet pulls orders for supported merchants with receipts, tracking numbers and shipping status; Track Package redirects to participating US carriers.
caveats: Not all merchants supported
Google does not issue refunds
Orders not in Gmail not shown
sources.local_note: Currently only available in the US. Wallet automatically pulls order information from your Gmail for supported merchants: detailed receipts, tracking numbers, shipping status. Package tracking must be enabled in Gmail; participating US carriers only.

sources.title: Manage items in Google Wallet
sources.page_scope: Item types, add methods (issuer, web, Gmail, photo, file), search, remove, share, transfer
sources.claim: Wallet holds payment cards, tickets, transit, loyalty/gift, car/hotel keys, corporate badges, student IDs, IDs, insurance/vaccine cards; Gmail auto-save requires Smart features + Auto save; photo/barcode passes; sharing of some passes.
caveats: Photo passes unavailable in India
Shared pass links cannot be unsent and can be forwarded
Website can add only loyalty and gift cards
sources.local_note: Types: debit/credit, boarding pass, event ticket, transit, loyalty, gift, digital car key, hotel key, corporate badge, student ID, drivers license, ID pass, insurance and vaccine cards. Auto save passes & receipts from Gmail. Add from photo (Everything Else). Search by business, amount, date, category. Share link can't be unsent.

sources.title: Loyalty cards & gift cards
sources.page_scope: Loyalty/gift card add, use, archive, limits
sources.claim: Loyalty and gift cards from supported merchants can be added, shown as barcodes or tapped (some programs), archived or removed; gift card add limit 10 per 30 days, 5 per merchant.
caveats: Google Play gift cards unsupported
Network-branded gift cards must be added as payment methods
Loyalty card added from Gmail disappears if email deleted
sources.local_note: Within 30 days, you can add up to 10 cards total and 5 cards per merchant. Google Play gift cards aren't supported; Visa/Mastercard gift cards must be added as payment method. Some loyalty programs let you tap your phone. Removing doesn't affect balance.

sources.title: Save & use flight or event tickets
sources.page_scope: Boarding passes, event tickets, screenshot add, real-time updates
sources.claim: Participating airlines/venues/brokers add tickets via Add to Google Wallet; NFC or barcode use; upcoming events appear on home screen; supported boarding passes show real-time gate/landing updates; Pixel 3+ screenshot-to-boarding-pass.
caveats: Real-time updates only for 'supported passes'
Push notification for gate change not explicitly stated here
sources.local_note: For upcoming events, your pass appears on the homescreen. For supported passes, like boarding passes, real-time updates directly on your pass: gate changes or landing statuses. Screenshot add: all Pixel phones version 3 and up. Saved boarding passes available offline.

sources.title: Manage passes notifications
sources.page_scope: Notification settings
sources.claim: Wallet can push notifications about transactions, passes and more; managed in Wallet settings.
sources.local_note: Turn on notifications from Google Wallet to receive push notifications about your transactions, passes, and more. Wallet settings > Manage Wallet notifications.

sources.title: Use Google Wallet for transportation
sources.page_scope: Open-loop transit tap, closed-loop transit passes, top-up, transfer, disputes
sources.claim: Supported systems accept card tap (same device+card in/out) or a bought/saved transit pass; Wear OS transit cards for Clipper, WMATA, PRESTO, ORCA, MARTA, Sofia; reload/autoload where supported; one device at a time; Google does not refund.
caveats: Mismatched entry/exit device may incur max fare
Charges may take 1-5 days to appear
Deleting Wallet/app data can lose passes
sources.local_note: Must use same device and payment method on entry and exit or may be charged maximum fare. Phone and watch are separate payment methods. Transit passes only on one device at a time. Add money, low-balance notifications, autoload for supported systems. Google does not issue refunds.

sources.title: Use Transit Insights in Google Wallet
sources.page_scope: Transit fare-capping progress card
sources.claim: Select transit providers offer a Transit Insights card linked to one payment card showing fare-cap progress, savings, recent trips and agency alerts.
caveats: Not a payment method
Only rides with linked card count
sources.local_note: Transit Insights: progress toward fare discounts and fare capping, savings over time, recent trips. Only certain transit providers in select regions. One Transit Insights card can only be linked to one card.

sources.title: Ride transit without opening Wallet on your smartwatch
sources.page_scope: Watch express transit
sources.claim: Express pay for transit is supported on Wear OS 4+; transit passes work without opening Wallet (Clipper excepted).
sources.local_note: Express pay for transit supported on all devices with Wear OS 4+. Wear watch and unlocked within 24 hours. Clipper passes aren't supported; open Wallet first.

sources.title: Add your US Driver's License or State ID
sources.page_scope: US mobile driver's license/state ID: states, setup, use, management
sources.claim: Listed states only (AZ, AR, CA, CO, GA, IA, MD, MT, NM, ND, OH, PR); state issuer verifies photos and selfie video; usable at TSA (REAL ID-compliant) and some apps; single device; on-device; removable remotely.
caveats: Not a replacement for physical ID
Offline >30 days disables ID
Issuer may delete ID at its discretion
sources.local_note: States: Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Puerto Rico. Android 9+, screen lock, Bluetooth and Nearby devices. Use with TSA at supported airports and some apps. Only one device. Offline more than 30 days = unavailable. Remove at myaccount.google.com.

sources.title: Create or manage your ID pass
sources.page_scope: Passport-based ID pass, TSA, PreCheck Touchless ID
sources.claim: ID pass from a passport (Brazil, Singapore, Taiwan, UK, US) via chip scan and face video; US-passport ID pass accepted at TSA for domestic flights; not official ID; one per passport; PreCheck Touchless ID enrollment from boarding pass.
caveats: Personal Gmail accounts only
Google may delete for fraud/security risk
sources.local_note: ID pass isn't an official form of identification. Regions: Brazil, Singapore, Taiwan, United Kingdom, USA. Scan passport chip; face video; automated match or manual review (<= ~30 min). Only US-passport ID passes at TSA for domestic flights. TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at 65+ major airports.

sources.title: Save your Student ID to Google Wallet
sources.page_scope: Campus student ID
sources.claim: Participating schools let students add an ID via school login for building access and campus payments; device must be bought in US, Canada or Australia; Android 9+ with NFC.
caveats: Balance managed in school app, not Wallet
Works without unlock unless 'Require device unlock' set
sources.local_note: Contact your campus card office. Building access and campus payments (dining, laundry, vending, books). Android 9+ with NFC. Student IDs only supported for devices bought in US, Canada, Australia. Remove via school account if phone lost.

sources.title: Set up or manage a digital car key
sources.page_scope: Digital car key pairing, passive entry, remote commands, lost phone
sources.claim: Select vehicles/markets: Pixel 6+, Galaxy S21+, select Android 12+; pair via manufacturer app, email link or head unit; passive entry, remote lock/unlock/alarm/trunk within Bluetooth range; remove/suspend via Find Hub.
caveats: No car make list on page
Samsung phones may use Samsung Wallet
Remote removal needs phone online
sources.local_note: Digital car keys only available for select vehicles in select markets. Pixel 6+, Galaxy S21+, select Android 12+. Passive entry on by default. Remote commands within Bluetooth range. Low battery: may unlock/start for a few hours. Find Hub: Erase device or Secure device to suspend key.

sources.title: Share a digital car key
sources.page_scope: Car key sharing roles and transfer
sources.claim: Owners can share Guest (access level + expiry), Co-owner or Service keys via link; activation by code, physical key or owner's key; revocation may be delayed by car.
sources.local_note: Key types: Guest (access level, expiration, reshare control), Co-owner (full access), Service (limited, no resharing). Access levels: No restrictions, Restricted driving, Access only. Some cars don't remove shared key until conditions met.

sources.title: Manage passes data
sources.page_scope: Pass data privacy controls
sources.claim: Personalization within Wallet and Use passes across Google (Maps, Calendar, Chrome) are on by default and can be turned off globally or per pass; payment methods managed separately; data in My Activity.
sources.local_note: Personalization within Wallet: on by default, can turn off. Use passes across Google (Maps, Calendar, Chrome): on by default, can turn off. Per-pass toggle 'Use pass across Google' in app only. myactivity.google.com/product/wallet.

sources.title: About private passes
sources.page_scope: Private pass protections
sources.claim: Health passes and IDs are private passes: labeled, may require verification to view, not used for personalization or across Google by default; Google does not verify some private pass content.
sources.local_note: Private passes: health passes, US DL/State IDs, ID passes, other sensitive credentials. Might require you to verify it's you to view. Not used to personalize by default. Google does not independently verify some info.

sources.title: Transfer a pass or card on Google Wallet
sources.page_scope: New-device transfer rules
sources.claim: Cards, transit, IDs, student IDs, badges, car/residential keys and private passes are device-bound and need transfer/re-add; loyalty, gift, event tickets and boarding passes sync via Google Account.
sources.local_note: Won't automatically appear on new device: credit/debit card, transit pass, mobile drivers license, ID pass, student IDs, corporate badge, digital car key, residential key, private pass. Auto-appear: loyalty and gift cards, event tickets, boarding passes.

sources.title: Tap to pay for kids
sources.page_scope: Supervised child tap to pay, limits, restrictions
sources.claim: Supervised children in listed countries can tap to pay with cards a parent adds; US child balance with daily spending limit and lock; restricted merchant categories; no online checkout until age of consent.
caveats: Fitbit not supported for kids
Watch must go online every 3 days for balance
Google cannot directly issue refunds
sources.local_note: Requires supervised Google Account, NFC Android or tethered Wear OS, payment method, screen lock. Parent email on successful payments, not failures. Daily spending limit via Family Link or web. Lock child's balance. Certain merchant categories blocked. Google Pay Balance Prepaid Visa issued by Pathward, N.A.; no ATM.

sources.title: Set up a balance in Google Wallet for kids (US Only)
sources.page_scope: Child prepaid balance setup and KYC
sources.claim: US family manager sets up a child's balance (prepaid Visa by Pathward) after identity verification by Google and partner (Marqeta KYC), sets a 4-digit PIN, adds money, assigns device.
caveats: Partner review ~72h; Google review ~48h
Other parent can add money after verification but can't set up
sources.local_note: Only the family manager can set up. Child under 18, supervised. Identity verified by Google and Google's partner (kyc@marqeta.com; docs within 14 days). 4-digit PIN, no sequences/repeats. Add money optional. Card issued by Pathward, N.A.; no ATM or cash access.

sources.title: Supported countries for Google Wallet & tap to pay - United States
sources.page_scope: US feature availability
sources.claim: In the US: Wallet app, tap to pay on phones, Wear OS watches and Fitbit, and the Google Wallet website are available.
caveats: Some passes depend on device/partner
sources.local_note: Your country supports tap to pay on phones, smartwatches with Wear OS, and Fitbit devices. Website manages payment methods, transactions, passes.

sources.title: Google Wallet launches new age and identity verification features
sources.page_scope: Announcement (Apr 2025): ID expansion plans
sources.claim: Announced that Arkansas, Montana, Puerto Rico and West Virginia would 'soon' support digital IDs and AZ/GA/MD/NM mobile IDs would work at the DMV.
caveats: Forward-looking announcement; West Virginia absent from the Oct 2026 help state list
DMV use not in help page's current-use list
sources.local_note: Residents in Arkansas, Montana, Puerto Rico and West Virginia will soon be able to save their government-issued digital IDs to Google Wallet. In Arizona, Georgia, Maryland and New Mexico, users will also be able to use their mobile IDs at the DMV.

sources.title: Bringing secure digital identity and payment tools to more people
sources.page_scope: Announcement (Jun 2026): EU ID passes, age credentials, direct checkout
sources.claim: Announced ID passes for select EU states (summer 2026), Sparkasse age credentials, Google Pay direct checkout for select Airwallex merchants (Adyen soon), Secure Payment Authentication rollout UK/Poland.
caveats: Non-US scope for most items
Partner-dependent rollouts
sources.local_note: Google Pay direct checkout available today for select merchants that use Airwallex and soon Adyen. ID passes to select EU member states this summer. Sparkasse age credentials. SPA with Visa, Checkout.com, Autopay, Adyen in UK and Poland in coming months.
